# Inventor

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## Become a Inventor

Franky built the Thousand Sunny's Coup de Burst out of cola barrels and confidence.

Choose Inventor as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Inventor

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Inventor XP +300

<a id="q-14f1d0043bbdac42"></a>

## Apprentice Inventor

Every genius starts with a workbench and a mess.

Reach Inventor level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Inventor](inventor.md#q-6900ae7e9d1c4610)

**Tasks**

- Reach Inventor level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Inventor XP +800

<a id="q-6b24a480d800acf5"></a>

## Journeyman Inventor

Karakuri Island is full of Vegapunk's old machines. Build a Whopper rod and piece a dial together from sky shell fragments.

Reach Inventor level 25, Make a Whopper Fishing Rod, Assemble a Mysterious Dial and land on a ruins island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Inventor](inventor.md#q-14f1d0043bbdac42)

**Tasks**

- Reach Inventor level 25
- Make a Whopper Fishing Rod
- Assemble a Mysterious Dial
- Land on a ruins island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Inventor XP +3,000

<a id="q-2715cf9fcd3d41db"></a>

## Expert Inventor

A dial that remembers a song, and a rod strong enough to land a Sea King.

Reach Inventor level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Inventor](inventor.md#q-6b24a480d800acf5)

**Tasks**

- Reach Inventor level 50
- Build the Tone Dial
- Build the Sea King Fishing Rod

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Inventor XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-24b28d6944840de8"></a>

## Master Inventor

Egghead has a genius in residence. Become the next one.

Reach Inventor level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Inventor](inventor.md#q-2715cf9fcd3d41db)

**Tasks**

- Reach Inventor level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
